# vastdata_compute_cluster_events (Data Source)

Events for a Kubernetes resource in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_events" "calico_controller_events" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
  resource_namespace   = "calico-system"
  resource_name        = "calico-kube-controllers"
  resource_kind        = "Deployment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_kind` (String) Kind of the resource (Pod, Deployment, Service, ReplicaSet).
- `resource_name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes resource.
- `resource_namespace` (String) Namespace of the Kubernetes resource.

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `events` (String) JSON-encoded list of events for the resource.
